problems.title: Your data should not need a new job before it can help you.

different.title: Every export looks different.
different.body: Columns move, headings change, and dates mean different things. A rigid template makes normal records feel broken.

cleanup.title: Manual cleanup steals the decision window.
cleanup.body: By the time the sheet is ready, the stock decision is already late and the reason for a sales change is harder to see.

certainty.title: A confident wrong answer is worse than no answer.
certainty.body: Suq keeps uncertainty visible, shows the evidence, and asks before an interpretation changes your totals.

how.title: From messy records to a useful morning view.
how.body: Suq separates understanding the source from committing it. That small review boundary is what keeps flexible ingestion trustworthy.

availability.question: Can I use this with my business today?
availability.answer: You can explore the fictional demo and try its local review and sale examples today. Real accounts, uploads, saved entries, subscriptions, and notifications are not available in this preview.

sources.question: Will I have to rename my columns or change my files?
sources.answer: The planned product accepts spreadsheets, CSV and POS exports, PDFs, and photos of records, alongside live entry. You review proposed field meanings instead of having to fit a fixed column template. The demo shows examples; it does not accept your files.

review.question: What if a field is unclear or a load is wrong?
review.answer: The planned workflow asks you to confirm uncertain field meanings before committing a dataset. Later corrections preview their effect on history, and an entire load can be undone. The demo lets you try field review and undo a sample sale without saving anything.

missing.question: Can sales alone tell me stock, returning customers, or profit?
missing.answer: No. Stock needs a starting observation and the relevant movements. Returning-customer analysis needs a confirmed customer identifier, and margin needs cost data. Missing evidence means an explained unavailable answer, not zero or a guessed result.

history.question: What happens to older records and downgrades?
history.answer: Planned Free history covers 90 days; older Free raw records are pruned nightly. After a Premium downgrade, older Premium-era data is hidden and retained for 13 months so re-upgrading can restore it during that period. Original upload files expire after 30 days on Free or 180 days on Premium. These retention rules are planned, not a claim that this preview stores uploads.

privacy.question: What does this demo save or send?
privacy.answer: The examples use fictional data; you cannot upload business records here. Your language choice is saved in this browser. Demo interaction events stay in temporary tab memory and are not sent to an analytics collector. The site host receives ordinary page requests. Production privacy terms and a public support channel are not yet published here.
